mechanism_narrative: A positive change in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month always leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days because it signals an impending monetary tightening that increases discount rates applied to equity cash flows.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods with positive FEDFUNDS change are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 255.5, it signals persistent inflation that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as investors demand higher risk premiums for inflation uncertainty.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 13.0 and industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 92.5, it signals a deteriorating labor market and weakening supply chain that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A positive change in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past quarter always leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days because it signals strong economic growth that increases corporate earnings expectations and reduces risk aversion.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in periods with positive GDPC1 change are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 92.0, it signals a weakening supply chain that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days as investors react to immediate supply constraints.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in < 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 900 and retail sales (RSAFS) decline below 405000, it signals a weakening consumer demand that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days as investors anticipate reduced corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in < 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply chain disruption regime, a falling industrial production (INDPRO) below 92.0 signals a weakening supply chain that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days as investors react to immediate supply constraints.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in < 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
